rows.text: Built to beat counters. Vorinclex's second line reads "if an opponent would put one or more counters on a permanent or player, they put half that many, rounded down" — and half of ONE is zero. Every proliferate trigger, every poison counter, every planeswalker tick, every charge counter on a mana rock that goes up by one simply does not happen. Then the deck adds a second anti-counter layer and a pile of artifact destruction, because that is where counter decks keep their engines.

rows.name: Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider
rows.text: 6/6 trample haste for six. YOUR counters double; THEIRS halve, rounded down. A one-counter effect from an opponent is blanked entirely, and even a four-counter proliferate becomes two.
He is a Praetor, so he also just attacks for six with haste the turn he lands. Against a non-counter table he is a beater; against a proliferate table he is the lock.

rows.name: Melira, Sylvok Outcast
rows.text: the second layer, and a different one. You cannot get poison counters at all, your creatures cannot have -1/-1 counters, and their creatures cannot have +1/+1 counters. Infect, toxic and -1/-1 strategies stop dead.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves

rows.name: Heroic Intervention
rows.text: hexproof and indestructible for the whole board through a wrath.
Counters need permanents to sit on, and in mono-green the answer to a permanent is to destroy it.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep a mana dork. Turn-one acceleration is what makes a turn-four or five Vorinclex possible, and he is the card the whole deck is named for.

Read the table before spending the artifact hate. Bane of Progress and Creeping Corrosion are close to blank against a creature deck and game-winning against an artifact one — hold them rather than firing on the first Signet.

rows.name: Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider
rows.text: remember the halving is rounded DOWN. A proliferate that would add one counter adds none. Against a deck built on single-counter triggers he is not a tax, he is an off switch.

rows.name: Melira, Sylvok Outcast
rows.text: two mana, and she answers a different set of decks than Vorinclex does. Against infect or a -1/-1 deck she is the more important card of the two.
